conditions.heading: General health
conditions.body: No chronic conditions; building fitness from a low base.

medications.heading: Supplements
medications.body: Vitamin D and magnesium in the evening; nothing prescription. Reviewed with primary care at the last annual check.

fitness.heading: 10K training block (July to October)
fitness.body: Aerobic base first: four easy runs a week climbing from 20 to 35 weekly kilometers, one tempo session added from mid-July, and a long run on Sundays. Goal is a sub-55 minute 10K in October.

fitness.heading: Strength
fitness.body: Two full-body sessions a week focused on hips, core, and single-leg stability to keep the running injury-free.

nutrition.heading: Baseline
nutrition.body: Whole foods, protein at every meal, coffee before noon only.

nutrition.heading: Fueling
nutrition.body: Carbs the night before long runs; electrolytes on anything over an hour.

providers.heading: Primary care
providers.body: Annual physical in spring; next check scheduled for next year.

providers.heading: Physiotherapist
providers.body: Seen monthly during the training build to catch niggles early.

metrics.heading: Resting heart rate and weight
metrics.body: Resting HR has dropped from 62 to 56 over the base-building block. Weight is stable at a healthy range. Sleep averages seven hours; the target is closer to eight on hard training days.
